what_this_column_represents: notes holds free-text comments typed by the sales rep
provenance_interpretation: `notes` is empty whenever the rep skipped the comment box
domain_context: in retail data, a missing note usually means nothing noteworthy happened

options.label: Impute the 91 missing values with the mode
options.method: the mode of `notes`'s recorded values, computed when cleaning runs, after exact duplicate rows are removed
options.assumption: the missing notes would have resembled the recorded ones

options.label: Exclude `notes` from analysis entirely
options.consequence: units_sold and every other column keep all 200 rows

options.label: Exclude the 91 rows where `notes` is missing
options.consequence: x1 and the other columns lose 91 of 200 rows

options.label: Keep `notes` as it is: its 91 missing values stay missing
options.consequence: nothing is imputed and no rows are removed. Statistics on `notes` will use only its recorded values, and the missingness is recorded in the cleaning report, where the Analyzer and Explainer will see it
